description: Alias assignment: S(a|form,C) = 10*id + 3*exact + 1.5*loose + 1.5*initial_match + 2*prior, veto identifier_conflict. theta=2.5, delta=0.5. The 'don't rely on one thing' rule is encoded in theta: initial_match alone (1.5) is BELOW theta, so initials never collapse unless corroborated by co-occurrence (prior, fed the form<->entity co-occurrence strength) or an exact/id match. A full exact name (3.0) or a strong id (10) clears theta on its own, as it should. A true tie between candidates (delta) parks -> LDU-P, never a blind alias assignment.
